Filter standardized enrichment results

Source: R/enrich-utils.R
filter_enrich_results.Rd

Subsets a standardized enrichment data.frame (the schema returned by run_enrichment()) to pathways that pass a significance cutoff on either the adjusted, raw, or q-value column, with an optional minimum gene-set size and direction filter.

Usage

filter_enrich_results(
  enrich_df,
  p_cutoff = 0.05,
  p_preference = c("adjusted", "raw", "qvalue"),
  min_genes = NULL,
  direction = NULL
)

Arguments

enrich_df

Standardized enrichment data.frame.

p_cutoff

Significance cutoff.

p_preference

One of "adjusted" (default), "raw", or "qvalue".

min_genes

Optional minimum number of overlapping / leading genes.

direction

Optional direction filter ("up" or "down"). Useful for GSEA where pathways carry a sign.

Value

Filtered standardized enrichment data.frame.
